results.comment: Observed initial FIRST_DENIED state with RATIONALE: true. Tapped REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION; Android displayed the location dialog, then tapped Don’t allow. Fixture returned with status “PERMANENTLY_DENIED: Continue without location or open Settings.” and “RATIONALE: false”. Visible controls: REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, REFRESH PERMISSION STATE, USE LOCATION FEATURE, CONTINUE WITHOUT LOCATION, and OPEN APP SETTINGS.
